what_works: Strong contrast between dark hero background and large white headline for immediate visual impact
Accent color (light green) used sparingly for version tags and interactive highlights, creating clear hierarchy
Generous whitespace and card-like containers separate content sections, enhancing readability and scannability
Consistent 4px rounded radius on buttons and UI elements provides a cohesive, modern visual language
Monospaced code snippets with copy buttons improve usability and encourage interaction
